verses.text: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will celebrate and bloom like a flower.
It will burst into bloom and shout for joy and sing. It will be given the glory of Lebanon and the beauty of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the beauty of our God.
Make the weak hands strong, and make the shaking knees firm.
Say to those who are afraid, "Be strong! Do not be afraid! Look, your God is coming to pay back your enemies. He is coming to repay them, and to save you."
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unblocked.
Then the lame will leap like a deer, and those who cannot speak will shout for joy. For water will burst out in the wilderness, and streams will flow in the desert.
The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground will become springs of water. Where jackals once lived, grass, reeds, and rushes will grow.
A highway will be there, a road called "The Holy Way." The unclean will not travel on it. It will be for those who walk in God's way. Fools will not wander onto it.
No lion will be there, and no wild animal will go on it. They will not be found there. Only those God has rescued will walk on it.

Those the LORD has set free will come back. They will enter Zion singing, and everlasting joy will be on their heads like a crown. Gladness and joy will fill them, and sorrow and sighing will run away.
